body_markdown:
TORONTO


, Nov. 19, 2026


/CNW/ - TD Asset Management Inc. ("TDAM") today announced the estimated 2026 reinvested distributions for TD Exchange-Traded Funds (each, a "TD ETF" and collectively, the "TD ETFs") listed below. These annual reinvested distributions generally represent realized capital gains within the TD ETFs.


Unitholders of record, as of the record date indicated below, will receive the actual 2026 reinvested distributions, which may vary from the estimated amounts indicated below. The actual taxable amounts of reinvested distributions for 2026 will be reported in late December 2026 or early 2027, and the tax characteristics of the distributions will be reported in early 2027.


Cash distributions will be reported separately.

About TD Asset Management


TD Asset Management (TDAM) is a global asset manager committed to helping clients achieve their investment objectives1. We are proud to serve institutional, intermediary and individual investors with solutions designed to address their evolving needs. Our specialized expertise and diverse perspectives enable us to navigate changing markets while pursuing long-term outcomes.


TDAM offers a broad range of investment capabilities across public and private markets: fundamental equity strategies such as free cash flow-driven approaches, quantitative and passive equities; fixed income mandates across the credit quality spectrum; and alternative offerings such as commodities.


1TD Asset Management represents TD Asset Management Inc. which operates in Canada and TD Asset Management (US), Inc. which operates in the U.S. Both entities are affiliates and wholly-owned subsidiaries of The Toronto-Dominion Bank. TD Asset Management products are also available through a network of affiliated and unaffiliated distributors. Please contact our distribution partners to find out more.
